name: Airtable
summary: Airtable has had two rounds of layoffs on public record: 254 people in December 2022 and 237 people in September 2023, both announced by CEO Howie Liu. No newer round is on record as of the date this page was checked.

facts.label: September 2023
facts.detail: Announced on 15 September 2023 by CEO Howie Liu.

facts.label: December 2022
facts.detail: Announced on 9 December 2022 by CEO Howie Liu in an internal email; the company's first layoff.

severance.figure: at least 16 weeks of severance pay, accelerated equity vesting, and immigration counsel for people on visas, as reported for the December 2022 round
